gates.evidence: Patterns: credentialed postgres URL, Bearer, ghp_, sk-, AKIA, ntn_, eyJ, private-key block, supabase.co, neon.tech over added lines (lighthouse/coverage artifacts excluded). One hit for 'sk-' is a substring of 'task-' in a Sprint_plan.csv row (false positive).

gates.notes: See finding F1. Branch changes no package.json or lockfile.

gates.evidence: case-types.router.ts: create/update/delete/setDefault all call assertCaseTypeAdmin (fail-closed isCaseTypeAdminRole; null role denied) after assertTenantContext; every procedure behind moduleTenantProcedure('LEGAL'); list/listActive read-only for LEGAL users; canEdit derived server-side.

Every caseType/checklist/case query in case-types.router.ts and cases.router.ts create+getById carries explicit tenantId (find, updateMany, deleteMany, count, groupBy, findFirstOrThrow). Foreign case type, client and assignee in cases.create return NOT_FOUND via tenant-scoped lookups. Prisma data built field by field (no input spread). Migration: composite FKs (tenantId, caseTypeId) on checklist items and cases (validated), RLS enabled with tenant_isolation policies (USING + WITH CHECK) on both new tables.
gates.notes: RLS is not FORCEd (project-wide, documented in the migration); the app-level tenantId filter is the primary boundary and is present everywhere.

gates.evidence: All mutations use Zod from @intelliflow/validators: trimmed length-bounded name, category and checklist titles; colorToken enum; SLA int 1..3650; requiredFields enum array max 6 with duplicate refine; checklist max from domain limits; ids via idSchema. DB CHECK constraints mirror the limits. Per-tenant type cap enforced.
gates.notes: Cap check (count then create) is a benign race; worst case slightly above the limit, no security impact.

gates.gate: SAST-style review: error leakage and injection
gates.evidence: Errors are generic (Case type not found, Client not found, conflict/precondition text). Only the caller's own submitted name is echoed in the CONFLICT message, as plain text. Unknown Prisma errors are rethrown to the tRPC formatter, not stringified. No raw SQL in router code. Web: grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, eval, console in case-types and new pages/components found nothing.
gates.notes: Migration is DDL only, no dynamic SQL, no data mutation (Class A per ADR-069).

gates.evidence: A01 access control: RBAC + tenant checks above. A03 injection: Prisma parameterised, Zod bounded. A04 insecure design: ADR-076; default and in-use guards enforced inside the write predicate (TOCTOU-safe updateMany/deleteMany) plus FK backstop. A05 misconfiguration: RLS + CHECKs. A09 info leak: generic errors.
